standard_prerequisites.name: Cone triangle in the homotopy category
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides (K, L, C(alpha), alpha, i, -p) as a distinguished triangle in K(Fil^f(A)).

standard_prerequisites.name: Filtered acyclicity of cones and its Hom consequence
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: lemma-filtered-acyclic (cited around 8492) and lemma-filtered-acyclic-is-zero (cited around 8505), both same chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies C(alpha) as filtered acyclic and kills the two outer Hom groups.

standard_prerequisites.name: Representable functor is homological
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the four-term exact Hom sequence attached to the cone triangle.

core_obligations: (1) 取锥三角 (K, L, C(alpha), alpha, i, -p)（lemma-the-same-up-to-isomorphisms）并确认 C(alpha) 过滤零调（lemma-filtered-acyclic）；对 I^bullet 施 representable-homological 得四项正合 Hom 序列（展示 xymatrix），两端由 filtered-acyclic-is-zero 消没，得 Hom(L, I)→Hom(K, I) 双射（约 8482-8510 行）。
(2) 局部化描述 Hom_K(L, I) = Hom_DF(L, I)：任一 DF 态射写成 gamma alpha^{-1}，由 (1) 提升 beta:L→I 使 beta∘alpha 同伦于 gamma——满性；反向设 beta∘alpha 同伦零，由 (1) 得 beta 同伦零——单性（约 8512-8523 行）。
proof_roadmap: (1) 锥三角 + 正合 Hom 序列 + 两端消没（约 8482-8510 行）。
difficulty_reason: 锥三角 + LES 消没为标准簿记且全程展示；(2) 的两个方向都明确化归到 (1)。
